body_text: Most teams are integrated in under a month. Use our pre-built components for a faster launch to market, or build natively against our API. Either way, our solutions engineers stay with you end-to-end.

BVNK gives you six core capabilities from a single integration: Send (global payouts), Receive (payment acceptance), Store (unified fiat and stablecoin accounts), Convert (real-time FX between fiat and stablecoins), Spend (card issuing against stablecoin balances), and Earn (rewards on idle balances
We're ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II certified, and independently audited against the highest standards for security and data management. See our full controls and credentials.
